textbookBox.concept: The textbook says that everything in our environment that can satisfy our needs is a resource, provided it is technologically accessible, economically feasible and culturally acceptable.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The textbook says that everything in our environment that can satisfy our needs is a resource, provided it is technologically accessible, economically feasible and culturally acceptable.
beats.speakEn: The textbook says that everything in our environment that can satisfy our needs is a resource, provided it is technologically accessible, economically feasible and culturally acceptable.

beats.en: Resources are not just free gifts of nature. Human beings transform materials into resources through technology and create institutions to speed up development.
